name: Patrol
objective: Sweep the sector and engage what you find.

brief.text: Raiders have been seen on the trade lanes. Take a turn through the sector and see them off.
They hide among the rocks here: mind the fields.
Your {side_name} patrol pay is the reward.

result.log: Patrol: outnumbered, the fleet drew off.
